title: init+scout
goal:
Навигатор мы настроили, теперь давай по скиллам, начиная с init. просмотри насколько он эффективно работает, познакомься с harness, engine, routes из репозитория.
Для init создай синтетические eval cases - 5шт
каждый кейс - проект на отдельном стеке. Они все должны быть полностью разные.
нужно откалибровать сборку config.yaml, сбор rules, оптимизация scout (тоже перевести на haiku)
тк на scout завязан навигатор, его мы оставим на конец, сохранив результат на sonnet и сначала сравнивая с ним. Потом по ним уже сравним навигатора не стало ли хуже

phases.title: Baseline and harness familiarization: read the init route (routes/init, engine, gates, scout step) and record how init works today; run init on one existing project to measure cost, turns, time and output quality (config.yaml, rules, scout context) as the sonnet reference.

Five synthetic init eval cases: five fixture projects on fully different stacks, generated by a script in evals/scripts (no stack-specific terms in code or prompts), each with deterministic graders on config.yaml fields, rules files and scout context; cases load and graders pass on a hand-made good result.

Sonnet baseline on the five cases: run the init cases x3 on the current setup (scout on sonnet), save per-case score, cost and turns to STATE.md as the reference to compare against; ask before the paid run.

Calibrate config.yaml assembly: fix the failing graders on config.yaml (detected profile, commands, paths) by editing the existing code or step text; the config graders pass on all five cases at least as well as the baseline, targeted tests green.

Calibrate rules collection: fix the failing graders on collected rules (relevance, no duplicates, grounded in the repo) the same way; rule graders pass on all five cases at least as well as the baseline.
Optimize init cost and speed apart from scout: remove redundant steps, reads and turns found in the traces; same or better scores at lower cost per run than the baseline on the five cases.

Scout on haiku: switch the scout subagent to haiku and compare with the saved sonnet scout results on the five cases (score, cost, funnel of context quality); keep haiku only if the scores are within the agreed tolerance, otherwise log the gap and the smallest fix to try.

Navigator regression check and wrap-up: rerun the navigator bench (6141 + 3571 + 6404 x3, then 10 cases x3 if no loss) on the new scout context and compare with haiku 932b65e4 (F1 .572); run npm run verify, bump the version, update STATE.md and commit.
